findings.finding: no canonical PriceObservation, ComparisonSnapshot, ProductMatchObservation, ProductMatchDecision, PriceCase, MonitoringPolicyRevision or CompetitorValueCard contract, store, service or API exists in the current Workshop branch.

ecommerce.price-governance lists three required object names but viewRefs, productionContractRefs, responsibilityTemplateRefs and impactCalculatorRefs are empty; evalPackRefs points to placeholder.json and actionTypes is empty.

the generic ResearchJob contract has no signed price research profile, provider/source allowlist, URL policy, source license decision, rate policy, currency/market scope, output schema or trusted manual-import contract.

no normalization authority converts provider artifacts into immutable price/currency/unit/promotion/shipping/tax/observed-at observations while preserving original refs and preventing external responses from overwriting Product price truth.

EvidenceBundle creation accepts caller-supplied coverage, freshness, conflicts and licenseSummary; no price required-facts profile computes originals, freshness, license, currency/unit comparability and source conflict coverage.
no versioned product-match feature schema, model/policy exact refs, confidence threshold, explanation/evidence refs, preliminary state or human MatchDecision authority was found.
no MonitoringPolicyRevision or anomaly policy authority binds category, market, channel, price basis, tolerance, freshness, evaluation publication and invalidation semantics.

no price research/monitoring Batch prepare/freeze state machine, immutable target set, per-target eligibility/exclusion, schedule/rate/capacity estimate, version CAS, zero-external-effect invariant or prepare Receipt exists.
no governed aggregation projection proves observation-to-originals reachability, deduplication, currency/unit consistency, late-event ordering and rebuildability before trend or anomaly use.

the price route currently renders only the common installed-module shell; no governance/competitor/schedule views, match review, observation originals, policy Diff, batch preflight or evidence disclosure is implemented.
W4-08 and W6-01 remain unchecked; exact Evidence/ResearchJob integration and assignee/capability readiness therefore cannot authorize W6-05 implementation or completion.
